name: frequency-shifter
description:
A frequency shifter: every partial moves by the same number of hertz.

Moving all partials by one amount, instead of scaling them as a pitch shift
would, breaks their harmonic relation: voices turn metallic, and small
shifts beat against the dry signal.  The spectrum moves by whole bins, so
the shift goes in steps of sr / bs (94 Hz at 48 kHz with blocks of 512).

spectrograms.label: Chirp (0 Hz → Nyquist over 5 s → decay)
